raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The DeepSeek-V4.1 sparse prefill path gathers its paged FP8 (SWA) and FP4 (compressed) KV into a BF16 workspace with `dequantize_k_cache_paged_v41`. Both kernels launch one program per token, which leaves the gather well below memory bandwidth.

## Modifications

- The V4.1 FP8 and FP4 dequant kernels process 8 tokens per program, with a masked tail. The FP4 kernel interleaves the low and high nibbles in registers and stores each row contiguously.
- `TestV41KVDequant`'s workspace-slice case now checks that rows on both sides of `out` stay untouched.

## Accuracy Tests

Output is bit-identical to the previous kernels on all four V4.1 layouts (split and token-interleaved, fp8 and fp4), including random bytes with NaN and -0.0 payloads. `test_v41_kv_store.py` passes on GB300.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Kernel time on GB300, page size 256, random token ids:

| Layout | Tokens | Before (us) | After (us) | Speedup |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| V41 (fp8) | 262,144 | 152.2 | 68.7 | 2.22x |
| V41 (fp8) | 1,048,576 | 585.6 | 250.6 | 2.34x |
| V41_NEW (fp8, interleaved) | 1,048,576 | 581.3 | 253.5 | 2.29x |
| V41_FP4 | 262,144 | 179.3 | 110.0 | 1.63x |
| V41_FP4 | 1,048,576 | 696.7 | 416.9 | 1.67x |
| V41_FP4_NEW (interleaved) | 1,048,576 | 679.0 | 414.5 | 1.64x |

Prefill step time, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash DEP2 on GB300 (`benchmark/engine_steps/bench_engine_steps.py`, 32K tokens per rank per step, 4K new tokens per request, ABBA):

| | Before (ms/step) | After (ms/step) | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Prefill step | 327.43 / 326.61 | 326.19 / 325.92 | -0.3% |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.
